A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] was the '''father''' of the Talz warrior [[Broonmark]] well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When Broonmark was young, his father was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by one of the predators on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], and Broonmark felt only shame at his elder's weakness.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Broonmark's father was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Broonmark in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
